name: ListIpams

parameters.help_en: The ID of the hosted region of the IPAM. You can call https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/448570.html to get the region ID
parameters.help_zh: IPAM托管地域ID。您可以通过调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/448570.html接口获取地域ID
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.help_en: The ID of the resource group to which the IPAM belongs
parameters.name: resource_group_id

parameters.help_en: The IDs of the IPAMs. You can specify up to 100 IPAM IDs
parameters.help_zh: IPAM的实例ID列表。N的取值范围为1~100，即一次最多查询100个IPAM实例
parameters.name: ipam_ids

parameters.help_en:
The name of the IPAM.

The name must be 1 to 128 characters in length and cannot start with `http://` or `https://`
parameters.help_zh:
IPAM的名称。

长度为1～128个字符，不能以`http://`或`https://`开头
parameters.name: ipam_name

fields.help_en:
The tag key. You can specify up to 20 tag keys. The tag key cannot be an empty string.

The tag key can be up to 64 characters in length. It must start with a letter or a Chinese character. It can contain digits, periods (.), underscores (_), and hyphens (-). It cannot start with `aliyun` or `acs:`, and cannot contain `http://` or `https://`
fields.help_zh:
标签键。最多支持输入20个标签键。一旦传入该值，则不允许为空字符串。

一个标签键最多支持64个字符，必须以字母或中文开头，可包含数字、半角句号（.）、下划线（_）和短划线（-），不能以`aliyun`和`acs:`开头，不能包含`http://`或者`https://`
fields.name: key

fields.help_en:
The tag value. You can specify up to 20 tag values. The tag value can be an empty string.

The tag value can be up to 128 characters in length and cannot contain `http://` or `https://`
fields.help_zh:
标签值。最多支持输入20个标签值。一旦传入该值，可以为空字符串。

一个标签值最多支持128个字符，不能包含`http://`或者`https://`
fields.name: value

parameters.help_en:
The pagination token that is used in the next request to retrieve a new page of results. Valid values:

You do not need to specify this parameter for the first request or when no next page exists.

If a next page exists, set the value to the NextToken value returned in the last API call
parameters.help_zh:
是否拥有下一次查询的令牌（Token）。取值：
第一次查询和没有下一次查询时，均无需填写。
如果有下一次查询，取值为上一次API调用返回的NextToken值
parameters.name: next_token

parameters.help_en: The maximum number of entries to return on each page. Valid values: 1 to 100. Default value: 10
parameters.help_zh: 分批次查询时返回的最多条目数。取值范围：1~100，默认值为10
parameters.name: max_results

Count.description_en: The number of entries returned on the current page
Count.description_zh: 分批次查询时返回的具体条目数

CreateTime.description_en: The time when the IPAM was created

DefaultResourceDiscoveryAssociationId.description_en: The ID of the default resource discovery association
DefaultResourceDiscoveryAssociationId.description_zh: 默认的资源发现关联关系ID

DefaultResourceDiscoveryId.description_en: The ID of the default resource discovery

IpamStatus.description_en:
The status of the IPAM. Valid values:

Creating: The IPAM is being created.

Created: The IPAM is created.

Deleting: The IPAM is being deleted.

Deleted: The IPAM is deleted
IpamStatus.description_zh:
IPAM实例的状态。取值：

Creating：表示创建中。
Created：表示创建完成。
Deleting：表示删除中。
Deleted：表示已删除

OperatingRegionList.description_en: The list of operating regions of the IPAM

items.description_en: The operating region of the IPAM

OwnerId.description_en: The ID of the Alibaba Cloud account to which the IPAM belongs
OwnerId.description_zh: IPAM实例资源拥有者的阿里云主账号

PrivateDefaultScopeId.description_en: The ID of the default private scope that is automatically created when you create the IPAM
PrivateDefaultScopeId.description_zh: 创建IPAM后，系统默认创建的私网IPAM作用范围

PublicDefaultScopeId.description_en: The ID of the default public scope that is automatically created when you create the IPAM
PublicDefaultScopeId.description_zh: 创建IPAM后，系统默认创建的公网IPAM作用范围

RegionId.description_en: The ID of the region where the IPAM is created

ResourceDiscoveryAssociationCount.description_en: The number of resource discovery associations

ResourceGroupId.description_en: The ID of the resource group to which the IPAM belongs

ScopeCount.description_en: The number of scopes in the IPAM. Valid values: 2 to 5
ScopeCount.description_zh: IPAM作用范围的个数。取值范围：2~5

MaxResults.description_en: The maximum number of entries returned per page. Valid values: 1 to 100. Default value: 10
MaxResults.description_zh: 分批次查询时返回的最多条目数。取值范围：1~100，默认值为10

NextToken.description_en:
The pagination token that is used in the next request to retrieve a new page of results. Valid values:

If NextToken is empty, no next page exists.

If a value is returned for NextToken, the value is the token that is used for the next query
NextToken.description_zh:
是否拥有下一次查询的令牌（Token）。取值：
如果NextToken为空表示没有下一次查询。
如果NextToken有返回值，该取值表示下一次查询开始的令牌
